thumb.displayName: Thumb (toggle and slider knobs, both themes)

themes.note: Dark is :root and [data-theme=dark]; Focus mode is always dark. Light is [data-theme=light], Desktop only. Components reference these role variables; values swap per theme.

dataColors.note: Hex lists in source that are data, not styling. Not part of the palette; never reuse as UI colours.
dataColors.garmentColourApproximations: components/tiles.tsx accentFor(): maps a garment's colour name (black, white, beige, navy, red, pink, ...) to an approximate hex used only to tint the backdrop wash; falls back to var(--accent).
dataColors.avatarPresetSwatches: routes/Onboarding.tsx PRESETS: six avatar colour choices (plum #632947, ivory #f4ead9, blush #f1c9d6, noir #2b1624, sage #9fb59a, sky #a9c4e0) offered as user options.

display.purpose: Signed-out / empty-wardrobe home hero headline only.

title.purpose: Detail-zone title under the rail, state headings, auth card titles; 1.5rem at <=600px.

title-sm.purpose: Rail titles, Focus clock, main-menu entries.

body.purpose: Running text and detail meta; tabular numerals globally; 60-70ch reading measure.

body-sm.purpose: Buttons (720), field labels (560), tile titles (720, two-line clamp).

label-caps.purpose: Tabs and top-nav links; at 0.8125rem for hint labels and quick-access section headings. Never a decorative label above a headline.

meta.purpose: Tile meta, field hints, tags, credits.

shadows.name: shadow-1 (dark)
shadows.purpose: Rest: buttons, tile media, toggle and slider thumbs.

shadows.name: shadow-2 (dark)
shadows.purpose: Raised: tile and primary hover, toasts, auth card.

shadows.name: shadow-lift (dark)
shadows.purpose: Lift: the selected tile, menus, drawers, dialogs.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: All keyboard focus; on tiles it sits on the media, not the text.

shadows.name: field-focus-halo
shadows.value: border-color: var(--focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus-ring) 35%, transparent)

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.purpose: The only sanctioned blur in chrome: the modal dialog ::backdrop.

motion.name: dur-2 (d2)
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions; overlay fade.

motion.name: dur-3 (d3)
motion.purpose: Tile hover/selection transforms and shadows; badge pop.

motion.name: dur-ring
motion.purpose: Notification bell: one damped swing on new notifications.

motion.name: dur-shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton shimmer loop; stops under reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for reveals and state transitions.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Drawers, dialogs and sheets sliding from their edge.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Reduced variant of every animation; loops stop. Triggered by prefers-reduced-motion or the reduce_motion setting ([data-motion=reduced]).

motion.name: backdrop-settle
motion.purpose: Backdrop repaints only after the selection rests this long; wash layers render at 25% size scaled 4x.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Compact detail zone, 60px top bar, 28px logo, no clock, no rail prev/next.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Bottom nav replaces menu button, top nav and hint bar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per view: paper on plum (dark), plum on paper (light).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 720; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: transform var(--dur-1, 120ms) cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #faf6f3); color: var(--primary-ink, #2b1624); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1, 0 2px 6px rgba(20,4,16,0.35)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #ffffff); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2, 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(20,4,16,0.6), 0 3px 8px rgba(20,4,16,0.3)); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: var(--dur-press, 60ms); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tinted 8px console key with a strong hairline for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 720; font-size: 0.9375rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 8%, transparent); color: var(--text, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.32)); transition: background-color 180ms, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 14%, transparent); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: var(--dur-press, 60ms); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 44px field, 8px radius, label above, hint below; focus-colour border plus 35% halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 560; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.32)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-0, #2f1430) 70%, transparent); color: var(--text, #fff); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--accent, #e07aa0); transition: border-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--text-3, #dcb3c6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0) 35%, transparent); } .ds-field-hint { color: var(--text-3, #dcb3c6); font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Uppercase tracked labels; 3px rose underline on the active tab; rose count pills.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-3, #dcb3c6); font-weight: 720; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: color 180ms; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.is-on { color: var(--text, #fff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-tab-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--accent, #e07aa0); } .ds-tab-count { margin-left: 8px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #e07aa0); color: var(--accent-ink, #2a1230); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: 44px filter label, 6px radius; selected fills with the primary colour.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.32)); background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #f6dfe7); font-weight: 560; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms, border-color 180ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--text-2, #f6dfe7); color: var(--text, #fff); } .ds-chip.is-selected { background: var(--primary, #faf6f3); color: var(--primary-ink, #2b1624); border-color: var(--primary, #faf6f3); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: 50x30 rounded track (round by function) in a 44px target; on fills rose; Thumb knob with the Rest shadow.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; width: 50px; height: 30px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.32)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 10%, transparent); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toggle.is-on { justify-content: flex-end; background: var(--accent, #e07aa0); border-color: var(--accent, #e07aa0); } .ds-thumb { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--thumb, #ffffff); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1, 0 2px 6px rgba(20,4,16,0.35)); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tile (selection lift)
components.description: One link per tile; 8px radius; 2:3 garment shown. Focus: 6px up, scale 1.04, 3px rose ring at 3px gap on the media, Lift shadow. Missing image renders the slot silhouette.
components.html: Image unavailableLinen-blend shirtDeclared · Not worn yet
components.css: .ds-tile { display: grid; gap: 12px; width: 170px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; outline: none; } .ds-tile-media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2, #53213f); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1, 0 2px 6px rgba(20,4,16,0.35)); transform-origin: 50% 60%; outline: 3px solid transparent; outline-offset: 3px; transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), outline-color 180ms; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-media { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2, 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(20,4,16,0.6), 0 3px 8px rgba(20,4,16,0.3)); } .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-media { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.04); outline-color: var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift, 0 26px 48px -16px rgba(18,3,14,0.75), 0 6px 14px rgba(18,3,14,0.35)); } .ds-sil { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 100%; color: var(--text-2, #f6dfe7); background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 9%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 3%, transparent)); } .ds-sil-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-3, #dcb3c6); } .ds-tile-title { font-weight: 720; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-tile-meta { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-3, #dcb3c6); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Hint Bar
components.description: Focus-mode footer: keyboard keycaps plus uppercase tracked labels; opaque Surface 0, no blur.
components.html: MMenuEnterOpen look/SearchEscBack
components.css: .ds-hintbar { height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--surface-0, #2f1430); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); } .ds-hints { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 720; font-size: 0.8125rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: var(--text-2, #f6dfe7); } .ds-key { min-width: 28px; height: 26px; padding: 0 7px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--text, #fff); color: var(--bg-bottom, #2a1230); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Menu Drawer
components.description: Opaque Surface 1 drawer with 56px entries that nudge 4px right on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-drawer { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 320px; padding: 24px; background: var(--surface-1, #3d1937); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift, 0 26px 48px -16px rgba(18,3,14,0.75), 0 6px 14px rgba(18,3,14,0.35)); } .ds-entry { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #fff); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 720; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-entry:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 11%, transparent); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-entry:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 11%, transparent); transform: translateX(4px); outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #e07aa0); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.description: Quiet hairline 6px label naming where a claim comes from; status tags mix ok/warn at 22-24%.
components.html: Simulated priceBaseline rankingReady
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 560; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text, #fff) 12%, transparent); color: var(--text-2, #f6dfe7); } .ds-tag-quiet { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.32)); } .ds-tag-ok { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok, #8ad9b0) 22%, transparent); color: var(--text, #fff); }

narrative.overview:
Wearhouse is the media-console home played straight: a Big Picture focus rail, a hero that the focused tile repaints, rail speed from the streaming apps, and retail clarity for garments, sizes and prices. Nothing is a costume or a metaphor; the conventions are the point, and the craft is in how cleanly they are finished. The world is luminous plum, never near-black: a vertical aubergine gradient lit from above, washed by the colour of whatever is selected.

Selection is the signature. One object at a time is "the" object: it lifts, takes a rose ring, dims its neighbours, retitles the detail zone beneath the rail, and (once the selection settles) tints the whole backdrop. Everything else stays quiet so that change reads. Density is console-loose in Focus mode and retail-dense on Desktop; both presentations share one token set, and Focus mode is always the dark world.

The light theme is the same system on paper: paper ground, ink text, plum primary, blush surfaces. It exists for Desktop only.
keyCharacteristics: Luminous aubergine gradient ground (top to bottom, 70% stop), never black.
Selection = 3px rose ring at 3px gap + lift shadow + spring scale, with neighbours dimmed.
The backdrop is repainted by the settled selection, not by every keypress.
Opaque chrome: top bar, hint bar, menus and drawers are solid surfaces.
One sans (Figtree Variable) carrying everything from 820-weight titles to tracked uppercase tabs.
Flat 8px tiles in three fixed ratios; authored slot silhouettes as the honest missing-image state.
Every motion has a reduced variant.

rules.name: The Luminous Plum Rule
rules.body: The darkest colour in the dark world is Aubergine Bottom (#2a1230). No near-black grounds, no grey neutrals; every neutral is plum-tinted.

rules.name: The Rose Means Here Rule
rules.body: Rose marks focus, the active tab or nav item, counts and on-states. If nothing is selected, active or counted, rose is absent.

rules.name: The Wash Is Borrowed Rule
rules.body: The only colour the backdrop takes beyond plum is the focused item's own tint at 55% in a radial wash; with no tint it falls back to the accent. The page never invents a decorative colour.

rules.name: The Data Is Not Palette Rule
rules.body: Two hex lists in source are data, not styling, and are not part of this palette: the colour-name approximation table that tints the backdrop wash from a garment's colour name (`accentFor` in the tiles component), and the six avatar preset swatches offered at onboarding (plum, ivory, blush, noir, sage, sky). Do not reuse their values as UI colours.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Step hierarchy with weight before size. A new level gets a new weight from the four variable stops, not a new font.

rules.name: The Caps Are Navigation Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text names places and controls (tabs, nav links, hint labels, short section headings inside a panel). It never sits above a headline as a decorative label.

rules.name: The Opaque Chrome Rule
rules.body: The top bar, hint bar, menus, drawers and dialogs are opaque surfaces with no backdrop-filter. Blur over the crossfading backdrop halved the frame rate. The only blur in the chrome is the dialog's own ::backdrop (6px over Backdrop Dim).

rules.name: The Lift Is Selection Rule
rules.body: The Lift shadow belongs to the selected object and to surfaces stacked above the page. Nothing at rest wears it.

dos: **Do** keep the dark ground a plum gradient from Aubergine Top to Aubergine Bottom; Focus mode is always dark.
**Do** mark selection with the 3px rose ring at a 3px gap, the Lift shadow and the focus spring, and dim the selected tile's rail neighbours.
**Do** let the settled selection repaint the backdrop with its own tint, after 140ms, never per keypress.
**Do** keep tiles to one link, 8px radius, in 2:3, 3:4 or 16:9.
**Do** show the authored slot silhouette with "Image unavailable" when an image is missing.
**Do** make paper-on-plum (dark) or plum-on-paper (light) the one primary action per view.
**Do** label provenance with quiet tags: simulated prices, baseline ranking, weather source and BMKG credit.
**Do** give every animation a reduced variant and keep targets at 44px or more.
**Do** show keyboard keys in the hint bar.
donts: **Don't** use near-black or grey grounds, gamer neon, or anything dark, murky or heavy.
**Don't** put backdrop-filter on the top bar, hint bar, menus or drawers; blur belongs only on the dialog's ::backdrop.
**Don't** use glow for focus or emphasis; depth is downward offset shadow.
**Don't** paint focus rings on mouse clicks in the Desktop presentation.
**Don't** recolour or add effects to the Wearhouse mark or wordmark beyond the supplied white and plum versions; the dark theme uses the supplied white lockup.
**Don't** put uppercase tracked labels above headlines as decoration.
